notes: Known from one post to rec.sport.pro-wrestling.fantasy (5 June 1999), served at /promotions/rspwf/archive/flash-critique-homicidal-jarrett-scott-1999-06-05.html: a Philadelphia-statue-talking lightweight with two chains and a Homicide finisher
caption: A blond-streaked lightweight with icy blue eyes who is 'The Most Homicidal Man In The World', June 1999.

tenures.note: Signed as a rookie cruiserweight into a triangle match for the vacant WPCW Cruiserweight title with Jamie Love and Chaos Kid; his own June 1999 flash says he won his first match and that title over those two.
Carded against Andrew 'Flash' Tucker in a cruiserweight match and introduced as the man who claims to be the most homicidal maniac in wrestling.
